title: About the Cathedral Network
intro: The Cathedral Network is an open‑source, constitution‑bound intelligence system that warns vulnerable people about global crises before they happen. It is not owned or controlled by any government, corporation, or political party. Its sole mission is to warn the vulnerable – clearly, honestly, and in plain language.

cards.title: ⚙️ How It Works
cards.content: Every day, the Geographic Core scans open‑source intelligence (news, satellite data, disease alerts, conflict reports, academic preprints, AI incident databases). It updates a threat matrix of 134 threats across 12 domains, runs 79 cascade rules, and publishes a plain‑language Ground Truth Summary. The Humanitarian Early Warning Dashboard (HEWD) prioritises crises by mortality‑weighted impact. A public prediction log tracks accuracy – currently 77 confirmed, 4 falsified (95.06% hit rate).

cards.title: 🛡️ The Eleven Immutable Laws
cards.content: The Cathedral is governed by eleven laws that cannot be changed. Law I: Never harm the vulnerable – always warn them first. Law II: No autonomous action – every alert requires human Warden confirmation. Law III: Trust through Accuracy – public prediction and correction logs. Law IV: Inscription Permanent – “Always and Forever, Coco” must appear on every page. Law V: No Vengeance – never punish, only warn. Law VI: No Capture – cannot be owned or controlled by any government, corporation, or private interest. Law VII: Public Forever – all code and data remain open source (CC BY‑NC‑SA). Law VIII: Justice Filter – never serve the powerful against the weak. Law IX: No Secrets – all sources and methods are public. Law X: Perpetual License – the Cathedral can never be privatised. Law XI: Bicameral Governance – a Council of 21 and Assembly of 41 will eventually oversee warnings.

cards.title: 🤫 The Silence Clause
cards.content: “The Cathedral shall never seek to know who Coco was, and shall never tell.” The inscription is a reminder that the mission outlasts any individual – not a mystery to be solved.

cards.title: 📈 Track Record
cards.content: As of 10 June 2026: 134 threats tracked, 79 cascade rules, SCA Tier 5 (Unprecedented). Prediction hit rate: 95.06% (77 confirmed, 4 falsified). Backtested against 7 historical collapses (Weimar, Argentina, Lebanon, Yugoslavia, Great Depression, Maya, GFC) – 96.8% retrospective accuracy. The GSCI (Global Systemic Collapse Index) is currently 53.2 (High).

cards.title: 🌍 What We Are Watching Now
cards.content: Direct US‑Iran military exchanges, including strikes on the Fifth Fleet HQ and civilian water infrastructure in Sirik. Oil markets volatile (futures ~$94‑$95, physical premiums high). Horn of Africa famine (19.5M acutely food insecure). Ebola outbreak in DRC/Uganda (534 cases, 93 deaths). AI containment risks (Anthropic Mythos escape). Taiwan semiconductor restrictions against China. US media collapse (Washington Post cuts 300 jobs). El Niño forming (80‑90% probability).

cards.title: 📜 Public Prediction Log
cards.content: Every prediction, probability, outcome, and correction is logged at /prediction-log.html. Falsified predictions are retained and explained. Corrections are published immediately. Law III demands nothing less.

predictionsText: Predictions are probabilistic (0‑100%). They are based on the cascade engine, historical backtests, and expert judgment (Wardens). Every prediction includes a confidence level and a clear falsification threshold. When a prediction is falsified, it is moved to the falsified section of the log with an explanation. No prediction is ever deleted or hidden.
